output_list.reason: The 'mint' function allows the preSale address to set balances of an arbitrary user to any value, causing an integer overflow in the balanceOf function.
The 'transfer' function allows a user to transfer any balance to an arbitrary address, causing an integer overflow in the balanceOf function.
The 'transferFrom' function allows a user to transfer any balance from an arbitrary address, causing an integer overflow in the balanceOf function.
The 'approve' function allows a user to set allowance to any value, causing an integer overflow in the allowance function.
The 'increaseApproval' function allows a user to increase allowance to any value, causing an integer overflow in the allowance function.
